tribute.title: Tribute
tribute.apiKeyHint: Generated in Tribute Creator Dashboard → Settings → API Keys.
tribute.credentialsNotice: Set TRIBUTE_API_KEY in the server environment and restart Flowvy. The key is never returned to this app.
tribute.apiAccessHint: Checks the first products page using a read-only request. It never creates a payment.
tribute.testError: Tribute API check failed. Verify the server key and try again.
tribute.receiverHint: Signed Tribute events enter a durable journal. Digital-product purchases use purchase ID idempotency; donations and subscriptions remain review-only until Tribute documents a unique payment identity.
tribute.executorHint: Provider mutations are controlled by server configuration. Review the activity journal before enabling automatic delivery.
tribute.signatureHint: Tribute documents the trbt-signature header over the raw request body. Flowvy will validate it before processing events.

rules.introHint: Digital-product purchases can be planned from a documented purchase ID. Donation and subscription rules stay review-only until Tribute exposes a unique ID for every payment.
rules.loadError: Could not load automation rules or access profiles.
rules.emptyHint: Create an explicit mapping from a Tribute payment scenario to one internal access profile.
rules.editorSubtitle: Match a payment, calculate access, then choose the internal entitlement.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.paymentModeHint: Choose whether this rule accepts one-time donations, recurring donations, or both.
rules.providerItemHint: Use the exact subscription or digital-product identifier from Tribute.
rules.priorityHint: Lower numbers run first when several rules could match.
rules.noActiveProfiles: Create or activate an access profile before saving an automation rule.
rules.accessProfileHint: Calculated days override this profile's default validity. Traffic, device limits, squads, tags, and provider options are reused.
rules.volumeHint: The highest reached band sets the rate for the whole payment: payment ÷ payment unit × access per unit, rounded down to whole days.
rules.previewHint: Runs the backend calculator only. It does not save the draft or change any user's access.
rules.previewError: Could not preview this rule. Check the values and try again.
rules.previewSessionExpired: Telegram session expired. Close and reopen the Mini App, then try again.
rules.previewForbidden: Admin access could not be confirmed. Reopen the Mini App or check administrator settings.
rules.previewInvalid: The backend rejected this draft. Review the rule values and try again.
rules.previewUnavailable: The preview service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
rules.toggleError: Could not change the rule status. Try again.
rules.saveError: Could not save the automation rule. Check the values and try again.
rules.deleteHint: Stops future matching. Existing activity keeps its rule and access-profile snapshots.
rules.deleteError: Could not delete the automation rule. Try again.
rules.deleteConfirmBody: {{name}} will be removed from Flowvy configuration.

reason.user_not_found: No existing Flowvy user matches this Telegram identity.
reason.user_inactive: The matching Flowvy user is inactive.
reason.subscription_not_found: The user has no linked Remnawave account.
reason.subscription_ambiguous: More than one linked account matches this user.
reason.rule_calculation_invalid: The matching rule could not calculate a safe duration.
reason.rule_not_found: No enabled rule matches this item, currency, and amount.
reason.profile_unavailable: The rule's access profile is unavailable.
reason.profile_not_grantable: The access profile does not grant active access.
reason.purchase_already_refunded: The refund arrived before this purchase and prevented delivery.
reason.refunded_before_apply: The purchase was refunded before access was applied.
reason.grant_cancelled_before_apply: The queued grant was cancelled without changing provider access.
reason.refund_source_not_found: The original purchase has not arrived yet.
reason.no_grant_to_compensate: The original purchase did not apply access.
reason.provider_identity_missing: The linked provider identity is missing.
reason.provider_identity_mismatch: The provider account does not match the paid Telegram identity.
reason.grant_plan_incomplete: The stored grant plan is incomplete.
reason.profile_snapshot_invalid: The stored access-profile snapshot is invalid.
reason.provider_state_conflict: Provider access changed outside this operation; automatic overwrite was stopped.
reason.provider_state_mismatch: The provider did not return the requested absolute expiration.
reason.refund_history_incomplete: The access history is insufficient for a safe compensation.
reason.refund_requires_revocation: Compensation would require revoking access and needs manual review.
reason.provider_temporarily_unavailable: Provider delivery failed temporarily; a retry is scheduled.
reason.provider_unavailable: Provider delivery failed after the retry limit.
reason.provider_rejected: The provider rejected this access update.
reason.worker_interrupted: A previous delivery attempt was interrupted and safely requeued.
reason.operator_retry_queued: An administrator queued one additional provider attempt.
reason.operator_resolved: An administrator closed this review without changing access.
reason.unknown: Automatic processing stopped for a safe review.

action.retryBody: Flowvy will make one more idempotent provider attempt using the stored plan and current identity checks.
action.retryBodyDisabled: Automatic delivery is currently off. This attempt will stay queued until it is enabled on the server.
action.resolveBody: This closes the review only. Flowvy will not grant, extend, replace, or revoke provider access.
action.noteHint: Required for the audit trail · 500 characters maximum
action.error: Could not save this decision. Review the current state and try again.
action.resolveSuccess: The review was resolved without changing access.
